The residual parent equity, AIMCo entry date, Manulife percentage and investment vehicle remain unasserted because they are not publicly disclosed.

afterImage.name: Boldyn Networks
afterImage.subsector: Neutral-host wireless, DAS, private networks, Wi-Fi, and fiber
afterImage.description: Boldyn Networks is a neutral-host digital-infrastructure platform providing distributed antenna systems, private networks, Wi-Fi, fiber and related shared connectivity for transit systems, venues, campuses, cities and mobile carriers. BAI Communications' Northern Hemisphere businesses adopted the Boldyn name in June 2023, and the U.S. regional perimeter—including Mobilitie, Transit Wireless, ZenFi, Signal Point and Apogee—operates within the same manager-level group rather than as a separate portfolio company. CPP Investments has backed predecessor BAI since 2009 and held 86% of Boldyn Networks at the latest direct stake disclosure on March 6, 2024; AIMCo held 10%. Manulife Investment Management retains a separately evidenced minority ownership interest in certain U.S. digital-infrastructure assets through Manulife Infrastructure Fund II, but its exact percentage and investment vehicle are not publicly disclosed. The residual parent equity, AIMCo entry date and later stake changes were not publicly disclosed, and no subsequent exit or signed ownership transfer was identified through September 3, 2026.

ownershipPeriods.stake: Minority interest in certain U.S. digital-infrastructure assets; exact percentage not publicly disclosed

milestones.event: The operating lineage that became Boldyn Networks traces its history to 1923.
CPP Investments entered predecessor BAI Communications and became its majority shareholder.
Manulife Investment Management clients acquired a minority ownership interest in certain U.S. digital-infrastructure assets associated with the platform.
BAI Communications combined its Northern Hemisphere businesses under the Boldyn Networks brand.
Boldyn integrated Apogee Telecom's higher-education connectivity platform into its U.S. operations.

CPP Investments, AIMCo and Manulife Investment Management announced additional capital for U.S. growth; the disclosure identified CPP's 86% parent stake, AIMCo's 10% parent stake and Manulife's minority U.S.-asset interest.
Boldyn Networks US completed approximately US$1.2 billion of senior secured debt facilities and notes, with no equity ownership transfer disclosed.
AIMCo disclosed that CPP Investments held 86% and AIMCo held 10% of Boldyn Networks.
Manulife invested in Boldyn Networks (US) through Manulife Infrastructure Fund II.
Boldyn closed the acquisition of Apogee Telecom's platform for higher education connectivity.
CPP Investments, AIMCo, and Manulife announced a new follow-on commitment to support U.S. growth.
Apogee Telecom officially rebranded as Boldyn Networks for higher education.
